c4.title: Base resonator: geometry-mode closure
c4.outcome: Independently accepted by Codex; R002 recovery and verdict-rule findings fixed. Identical arm: formation 20/20, two-way causality and dose-response PASS, 39/39 effective units within bounds; H-M and H-C precursor SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE. Heterogeneous arm: formation 5/20, H-M INCONCLUSIVE, H-C precursor NOT_SUPPORTED. No hierarchy, task or efficiency claim. Owner decision: C4's own files are frozen; shared pipeline tools are pinned to the accepted evidence commit

c5.title: Many resonators form one effective resonator
c5.outcome: Independently accepted by Codex (R003; R001 withdrawn, R002 CHANGES_REQUIRED). H-M level 2 SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE: G->M, M->G and both dose ladders PASS with complete ablations exactly 0. H-M is supported within the registered R003 scope for the formed groups; formation is near the pass threshold (17/30; earlier revisions 15/30 and 13/30), and this panel does not establish a population formation rate above 50%. H-C first transition INCONCLUSIVE: downward effect, emergent transfer, effective state, timescale separation (3.4x) and the published level-2 interface PASS, but the port coarse law does not beat relaxation with a measured tau2. No recursion, next-level predictive accuracy, usefulness, efficiency or novelty claim. Open low notes N1-N3 (review). Owner decision: C5's own files frozen; shared pipeline tools pinned to the accepted evidence commit
